title: ServiceRunResult
description: A run that ended: its instance exited. Sent once the instance's container has exited, after all of its output.

exitCode.description: The instance's exit status: the service's own, since nothing supervises it (R1). An instance a signal ended exits with 128 and the signal's number: 143 for SIGTERM, 137 for SIGKILL.

ranMs.description: Milliseconds from its container's start to its exit.
